gigapan.name: monochrom's office, on a messy day
gigapan.description: There is only now, this minute. I set up the gigapan and went for breakfast. I assumed I would take several, many, gigapans of the monochrom office. But so far, this is the only one. And it didn't complete - it was supposed to be a 360, and the color balance seems off, and some images were missed. And I messaged Johannes that I was taking a GigaPan of the office. He said, no, wait, it is so messy from RoboExotica, wait until we tidy up. And I responded with a definition to the word 'Tidy' ----- Tidy is a special word we use to describe a space which on Earth has achieved the perfection we imagine for Heaven. When we tell ourselves to wait, to not show something until it is tidy we are taking onto ourselves the role of ultimate control, the power of creating the order reserved for processing souls to their eternal reward and damnation. We are all sinners to the false god of Tidy. Notes: this does not apply to the actions of roommates in a shared kitchen. In that case it is acceptable to demand that those filthy slobs should get their shit together, show a little respect, and tidy up.
